Genesis 21:30 records Abraham's gift of seven ewe lambs to Abimelech "as a witness" of his well-digging rights. Genesis 31:52 establishes a heap of stones as "witness" between Jacob and Laban. Joshua 24:27 twice declares a great stone set up as "witness" to Israel's covenant with God. The E source prefers this feminine form for things, while J uses the masculine עֵד."

}
